---
id: bar-tailed-godwit
title: Bar-tailed godwit
---
The bar-tailed godwit (*Limosa lapponica*), especially subspecies
*baueri*, leaves Alaskan breeding tundra and flies nonstop across the
Pacific to New Zealand and eastern Australia, then returns along a more
westerly arc in the opposite months. Pre-departure fattening fuels days
of continuous flight. A long, slightly upturned bill probes intertidal
mud.
